title: A tiny file system
description:
Keep folders and files in nested dictionaries and move around them with commands.

```
/ > mkdir docs
/ > cd docs
/docs > write notes.txt hello
/docs > ls
notes.txt (5 bytes)
/docs > cd ..
/ > tree
/
  docs/
    notes.txt
```
hints: `isinstance(value, dict)` tells a folder from a file (lesson 6.04).
`tree` is recursive: print the folder's name, then call itself for each child with more indentation.
requirements: A folder is a dictionary; a file is a string.
Keep the current path as a list of names.
stretch: Add sizes to `tree` and a total for each folder.
